use vstd::prelude::*;

verus! {

pub trait One {
    fn one(&self) -> (r: u32)
        ensures
            r == 1,
    ;
}

pub struct S;

pub fn use_it<T: One>(s: &T) -> (r: u32)
    ensures
        r == 1,
{
    s.one()
}

#[verifier:: // disciplines:allow-trusted (spike b)
    external]
impl One for S {
    fn one(&self) -> (r: u32) {
        6
    }
}

} // verus!
